headline: Colonials Tighten Grip on Godcrofts; Weathered Expanse Flares Anew
war_summary: Three hours further into the war's 176th day, Godcrofts has tipped still harder: the Colonials now hold eight of its nine works against a single Warden foothold, flags logged as this edition goes to press and Argosa, Fleecewatch, Isawa, Lipsia and Saegio each thrice-struck. Weathered Expanse, the day's costliest ground, burns on — eleven actions inside two hours and thirty-eight in twenty-four, one work now a ruin, Wightwalk and Spirit Watch the storm-centers, the day's dead past nineteen thousand. Callahan's Passage has raised no new flags since morning, yet its ledger is the grimmest afield: nearly eleven thousand fallen in a day and the hourly toll still climbing. Linn of Mercy bleeds steadily about The First Coin; Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf have slackened, though Stlican's forty-six actions remain the busiest count; the Dead Lands have gone silent after eighteen. Oarbreaker's guns, long still, opened again within the last two hours. The tally reads 273 works Colonial, 154 Warden, one in ruin; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize and no victor is named.
